description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'DataCollections' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Data collections - the creator's own data structures, a Firebase/Supabase-like store inside the platform for games, apps and sites. USE A READY PLATFORM MODULE FIRST (currencies, items, store, lootboxes, quests, leaderboards, chat, social, workshop, match, season, tutorial, localization, push, analytics); declare a collection only for what no module provides (guilds, auctions, orders, catalogs, articles, saved levels, feeds, mail) or for extra data attached to module entities. NEVER store currencies or items inside a record: reference them with a Ref field (Kind Item/Currency/User/…) and move value with Economy (Cost/Grant in engine resource format, charged in the same transaction as the write). Collections maps a collection id (letters, digits, '_', '-', ':' up to 64; a front-end module prefixes its namespace, e.g. 'guild-system:guilds') to: Kind (UserOwned: each record belongs to one user; Shared: records used by many users; Temporary: short-lived, mandatory TTL up to 30 days; Log: append-only, read by time); Mode (Strict = only declared fields); Fields (String, Text = searchable by words, Int, Number, Bool, Date, Json, Array with ItemType, Ref with Ref.Kind, File) with Required/Default (JSON literal)/Min/Max/MaxLength/MaxItems/Enum/Unique/Indexed/Visibility (Everyone/Owner/Server)/ClientWritable=false for server-only fields/Immutable; SortKeys (id + 1..4 components, each a scalar field or createdAt/updatedAt, optionally Descending) - every ordered query uses one, and equality filters on its leading components narrow the range; Access with Read/Create/Update/Delete lists of rules OR-ed together (Anyone - Read only, Authenticated, Owner, Members with MembersField = an Array of Ref(User), Role with a role id from Roles, Server); Limits (MaxItemBytes, MaxItemsPerOwner, TtlSeconds); OnOwnerDeleted (Delete/Anonymize/Keep); Counters (Count or Sum, optional GroupBy - maintained atomically, not allowed for expiring records); Integrations (QuestMetricOnCreate/Update/Delete advance quest objectives with Source ServerApi, AnalyticsEventOn*, TriggerOn* run a CloudCode handler asynchronously); Moderation.BlockedTerms; WriteGate (SegmentGate); PublicViews (published to the CDN for anonymous/site reads: SortKey, optional PartitionField, PageSize, MaxItems, PublishItems) and AnonymousSearch. Queries from a game may filter ONLY by Indexed fields and sort ONLY by declared SortKeys - there are no table scans on the shared cluster. Roles lists title user roles; they are assigned only by CloudCode (server.SetUserRoles) and the dashboard. The count of collections, searchable fields, sort keys, record size and storage are capped by the plan. Records themselves are NOT here - they live in the engine's DataCollection* collections; CloudCode reads and writes them with server.GetDataItem/QueryDataItems/CreateDataItem/UpdateDataItem/DeleteDataItem/BatchDataItems/GetDataCounter.

x-enum-descriptions: Platform was not reported, or the reported one contradicts the request fingerprint.
Browser: web build, WebGL, or a messenger mini-app.
Android build (Google Play Billing).
iOS / iPadOS build (App Store, StoreKit).
Anyone, including visitors without a session (Read only; served from the CDN / cache, never straight from the database).
Any signed-in user of the title.
The owner of the record.
A user listed in the record's MembersField.
A user who has the Role.
Server only (CloudCode, dashboard).

MembersField.description: For Members: the name of an Array field of Ref(User) listing the members.

Role.description: For Role: the role id from DataCollections.Roles.

DataCollectionAccess.description: Access rules. Each operation takes a list of rules combined with OR. null/empty list = Server only. The server (CloudCode, dashboard) is never restricted by these rules.

Create.description: Who can create records. For UserOwned the creator becomes the owner; for Shared the creator becomes the owner when the rule is Authenticated/Owner. A client-created record is whatever the player typed: a collection the game TRUSTS (ledger, balances, asset registry, transfers, results) must be written by the server only — leave Create empty (= Server) and write it from CloudCode.

Read.description: Who can read records. A rule wider than Owner (Authenticated, Anyone) lets EVERY player read EVERY record — including other players' records in a UserOwned collection. Personal data (wallet addresses, transaction signatures, a player's ledger, emails) must stay Owner/Server: keep Read = Owner, or hide such fields with field Visibility = Owner/Server and open only the rest.

DataCollectionDefinition.description: A data collection declared by the creator.

Access.description: Access rules for Read / Create / Update / Delete.

AnonymousSearch.description: Allow live anonymous search by declared searchable fields (site search). Answers are cached in Redis for 30 s and limited per network. Default false. Requires Access.Read to include Anyone.

Counters.description: Declared aggregates maintained atomically on every write (count of records per field value, sum of a numeric field). Read them instead of scanning.

Description.description: What this collection stores (documentation for the dashboard and the AI coder).

DisplayName.description: Display name (a localization key or a literal).

Economy.description: Economy of client operations in engine resource format: Cost is charged and Grant is given in the SAME transaction as the write ('create a guild = 500 gold'). Value always moves through the engine economy, never inside a record.

Enabled.description: A disabled collection is neither readable nor writable. null = enabled.

Fields.description: Record fields. Key = field name (letters, digits, '_' up to 64 chars).

Integrations.description: Integration with other platform modules: quest progress, analytics events, leaderboard score, push notifications, CloudCode triggers.

Kind.description: Data class — decides physical storage, indexes and lifetime. UserOwned: each record belongs to one user (saves, orders, builds). Shared: records shared by many users (guilds, auctions, catalog, articles). Temporary: short-lived records with a mandatory TTL (invites, lobbies, carts). Log: append-only records read by time (history, feed, messages, audit).

Limits.description: Limits: record size, records per owner, TTL.

Mode.description: Strict: only declared fields are accepted. Loose: declared fields are validated, undeclared ones are accepted as free-form JSON (not searchable).

Moderation.description: Moderation of user-written text fields (blocked terms).

Namespace.description: Creator's own namespace (grouping in the dashboard and for the AI coder). Does not affect storage.

OnOwnerDeleted.description: What happens to a user's records when the account is deleted: Delete (default), Anonymize (owner removed, record stays), Keep.

PublicViews.description: Public views published as static files to the CDN (R2) for anonymous and logged-in reads without touching the database. Requires Access.Read to include Anyone. Only fields visible to Everyone are published. Freshness is seconds, not instant.

SchemaVersion.description: Schema version, stamped on each record. After a field type change old records are re-validated lazily on their next write.

SortKeys.description: Declared sort keys, including composite ones ('region' then 'score' descending). Every ordered query must use one of them. Equality filters on the leading parts narrow the range.

Tags.description: Free-form tags (grouping and search in the dashboard).

WriteGate.description: Audience gate for client writes. null = everyone allowed by the access rules.

DataCollectionEconomy.description: Economy of client operations. Charged/granted in the same transaction as the write, idempotent per record operation.

OnCreate.description: Create: Cost is charged from the creator, Grant is given to the creator.

OnDelete.description: Delete by a client: Cost and Grant (e.g. a refund) for the caller.

OnUpdate.description: Update by a client: Cost and Grant for the caller.

AnalyticsEventOnCreate.description: Custom analytics event logged for the acting user on create (server-side, same rules as server.LogEvent). Params: collection, itemId.

QuestMetricOnCreate.description: Quest progress: objectives with Source = ServerApi and this MetricID advance by 1 for the acting user when a record is created.

QuestMetricOnDelete.description: Quest metric advanced when a record is deleted by a client.

QuestMetricOnUpdate.description: Quest metric advanced when a record is updated by a client.

TriggerOnCreate.description: CloudCode handler run asynchronously (queue, retries) after a record is created. args = { Trigger, Collection, ItemID, Item, Previous }.

TriggerOnDelete.description: CloudCode handler run asynchronously after a record is deleted.

TriggerOnUpdate.description: CloudCode handler run asynchronously after a record is updated.

x-enum-descriptions: Each record belongs to one user (saves, builds, orders, documents, settings).
Records shared by many users (guilds, auctions, catalog, articles, world shards, tournaments).
Short-lived records with a mandatory TTL (invites, requests, lobbies, carts, codes).
Append-only records read by time (battle history, feed, order journal, messages, audit). No updates.

DataCollectionLimits.description: Collection limits. Every value is additionally capped by the title's plan.

MaxItemBytes.description: Maximum record size in bytes (serialized data). null = 16384, capped by the plan.

MaxItemsPerOwner.description: Maximum records one user may own in this collection. null = unlimited (within the title limit).

TtlSeconds.description: Record lifetime in seconds. Mandatory for Temporary (max 30 days). For Log it is the retention (capped by the plan). null for UserOwned/Shared = permanent.

BlockedTerms.description: Blocked terms checked in every String/Text field written by a client. A match rejects the write.

Description.description: What the role is for (documentation only).

x-enum-descriptions: Only declared fields are accepted.
Declared fields are validated, undeclared ones are accepted as free-form JSON (not searchable, not sortable).

DataCounterDefinition.description: A declared aggregate maintained on every write.

GroupBy.description: Group by the value of a scalar field (e.g. members per guild, orders per status). null = one total per collection.

Kind.description: Count: number of records. Sum: sum of SumField.

SumField.description: For Sum: an Int or Number field.

Visibility.description: Who can read the counter: Everyone (default) or Server.

x-enum-descriptions: Number of records.
Sum of a numeric field.

AllowedMimeTypes.description: File fields: allowed content types (image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif, application/json, model/gltf+json, model/gltf-binary, application/zip, text/plain, application/octet-stream). null = any of them. The server checks the real file signature against the declared type.

ClientWritable.description: false = only the server (CloudCode, dashboard) writes this field — scores, guild level, order status. Client writes to it are rejected. null = client-writable.

Default.description: Default value as a JSON literal (1, "EU", true, []). Applied on create when the field is absent.

Immutable.description: The field cannot be changed after creation.

Indexed.description: The field can be used in query filters (equality, in, range, array-contains, prefix). Queries from a game/app may filter ONLY by searchable fields. Text fields are searched by words and word prefixes.

ItemType.description: Element type for Array fields (a scalar type or Ref). null = Json elements.

Max.description: Maximum (numbers and dates as unix ms).

MaxFileBytes.description: File fields: maximum file size in bytes. null = 10 MB; at most 100 MB. Files live in the platform's private bucket, count toward the publisher's storage and are read through short-lived signed links.

MaxItems.description: Maximum number of elements for Array fields.

MaxLength.description: Maximum length: characters for String/Text, UTF-8 bytes for Json.

Min.description: Minimum (numbers and dates as unix ms).

Ref.description: Reference target for Ref fields (and arrays of Ref).

Required.description: The field must be present on create.

Unique.description: Value must be unique within the collection (email, slug, nickname). Enforced by the database inside the write transaction.

UniqueIgnoreCase.description: Uniqueness ignores letter case (only for String fields with Unique).

Visibility.description: Who can see the field: Everyone (default), Owner (the record owner only), Server (CloudCode and dashboard only).

x-enum-descriptions: A string (up to MaxLength characters, default 256).
Long text searched by words and word prefixes (up to MaxLength characters, default 4000).
A 64-bit integer.
A floating point number.
true / false.
A date-time in UTC (ISO-8601 string or unix ms on input).
Any JSON value (not searchable). Size limited by MaxLength bytes.
An array. Element type is ItemType. Arrays of scalars are searchable with array-contains.

A reference to another entity: a record of a collection, a user, an item, a currency, an item instance, a store offer, a leaderboard, a quest, a workshop publication. Validated on write, expandable on read.
A file stored in the platform's private bucket; the record keeps a reference and clients get signed URLs.
Visible to everyone who can read the record.
Visible only to the record owner.
Never returned to clients: CloudCode and dashboard only.

DataOperationEconomy.description: Cost and grant of one operation.

x-enum-descriptions: Records owned by the user are deleted (default).
The owner is removed, the record stays (e.g. a guild outlives its founder).
Records are kept as they are. The new owner of the same user id still does NOT inherit them (ownership is checked against the registration date).

DataPublicViewDefinition.description: A public view published to the CDN as static pages.

MaxItems.description: Maximum records published per partition (default 1000, max 5000).

PartitionField.description: Optional: a separate page set per value of this searchable field (category, region). Must be the leading component of SortKey.

PublishItems.description: Also publish one file per record (items/{id}.json).

SortKey.description: Sort key id the pages are ordered by.

x-enum-descriptions: A record of a data collection (Ref.Collection).
A user of this title (user id).
An item definition of the title's Item config ("CatalogID/ItemID" or a unique ItemID).
A currency of the title's Currency config (virtual or crypto currency id).
A player's item instance id (non-stackable item).
A store offer id.
A leaderboard id.
A quest id.
A workshop publication id.

Collection.description: For DataItem: the target collection id.

Validate.description: Check that the target exists on write. null = yes.

DataSortComponent.description: One component of a sort key.

DataSortKeyDefinition.description: A declared sort key: one or more components. Queries order by a sort key; equality filters on its leading components select the range ('region = EU, by score').

Components.description: Components in order. Each is a scalar field (String, Int, Number, Bool, Date) or the built-in 'createdAt' / 'updatedAt'.

EventTokenAddress.description: Universal event-token address. Uniquely identifies the system and event the tokens belong to.

EntityID.description: Event identifier within the system. In TITLE CONFIG (rewards written by a designer or an AI agent) scheduled systems use the SHORT form — the cycle number is unknowable at config time: "{TimedEventID}" / "{LeaderboardID}" = whichever instance is active at grant time, or "{ID}:{ChainedEventID}" = that chain phase in the current cycle. The engine (EventTokenAddressResolver in ResourceService) expands it before granting; a grant with no active instance is dropped. At RUNTIME the bucket address is always the full form "{EntityID}:{InstanceKey}": TimedEvent Scheduled → "{TimedEventID}:s{yyyyMMddHHmm}"; TimedEvent Chain → "{chainID}:{cycleIndex}:{chainedEventID}"; Leaderboard → "{leaderboardID}:{instanceKey}"; CoopEvent → CoopChainID; Season → SeasonChainID.

EventTokenOperation.description: Information about granted event tokens. Returned in Board_Roll, QuestComplete and other responses. All multipliers (Roll/Premium/BonusWindow/ProgressiveTier/SeasonBuffs) are applied via ModifierService before ResourceService; this carries the final amount. Use ModifierApplyResult alongside ResourceOperation if UI needs multiplier breakdown.

Address.description: Event token address — where to grant or consume.

Amount.description: Token amount — how many to grant or consume.

Source.description: Operation source (sourceKey used for analytics and limits).

ExperimentVariantCondition.description: Experiment-variant membership condition — embedded in SegmentGate.Experiment. The gate passes if the player is assigned to one of Variants of experiment ExperimentID (empty list = just enrolled). A/B variants thus reuse the whole SegmentGate stack: make two configs (offer A, offer B), each gated to its variant.

ExperimentID.description: Experiment ID whose assignment is checked.

Variants.description: Allowed variants (any-of). Empty = being assigned to any variant is enough (enrolled). A player with no assignment for this experiment does NOT pass.

ResourceBundle.description: Set of items, currencies and tokens for a single operation direction (grant only or consume only).

ResourceEntry.description: Universal container for a single entry in a resource bundle (item or currency). The set of populated fields depends on Type: Item uses CatalogID/ItemID/Amount; VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency uses CurrencyID/Amount; Purchase uses only ProductID (paid in a store).

Amount.description: Amount of the resource. Used by every type except Purchase, where the quantity is decided by the store itself and this field is ignored. Amount=0 is valid in Consume.PremiumTiers and means 'do not charge'.

AmountUsd.description: CryptoCurrency only: the amount in USD instead of a token count. At the moment of the operation the engine converts it to tokens at the LIVE market price of the token (charge: rounded up to a whole token; grant: rounded down). When set, Amount is ignored; the operation result carries the converted Amount.

CatalogID.description: Item catalog identifier. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs (e.g. "main", "season").

CurrencyID.description: Currency identifier. Used only when Type is VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies or cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

ItemID.description: Item identifier within the catalog. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs[Catalog].Items.

ProductID.description: IAP product identifier. Used only when Type is Purchase. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Purchase.Products — OUR stable product ID, not the store SKU (per-store SKUs live in IapProductDefinition.StoreProductIDs).

Type.description: Resource type. Determines which fields must be populated: Item (catalog item), VirtualCurrency (off-chain), CryptoCurrency (on-chain), or Purchase (real-money payment in a store).

x-enum-descriptions: Catalog item. Requires CatalogID, ItemID and Amount.
In-game (off-chain) virtual currency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies.
On-chain cryptocurrency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

Real-money payment in a store. Requires only ProductID (a product from cfg.Purchase.Products); the amount and currency are decided by the store from the SKU price tier. NOT a storable resource and never passes through ResourceService — the money is paid outside before the server learns about it, so the entry is consumed by the receipt check (ExternalPaymentGate) and stripped before the resource operation. Allowed only in Consume and only for Consumable products.

Rewarded-video credit. One credit equals one verified ad view that can be spent in systems requiring rewarded video (lootbox open, reward double, re-roll, booster). Granted +1 per server-verified view, or as N from milestones/quests/premium perks; spent -1 per gated action.

SegmentGate.description: Unified "who it is available/applies to" gate. Replaces BoostSegmentGate (TimedBoost), MailboxSegmentDefinition filters and StoreOfferRules premium fields. All conditions are AND-ed. An empty/unset field = no constraint on that axis; an empty/null gate = available to everyone. Resolved by SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes.

ActiveWithinDays.description: Active within the last X days (matches Usage.LastActiveAt). 0 = no restriction.

Countries.description: Country filter (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; matches PublicData.Country, else RegistrationCountry). Empty = all countries.

Experiment.description: A/B experiment condition: the gate passes only if the player is assigned to the required variant (ExperimentVariantCondition). null = not applied. A/B variants thus reuse the whole SegmentGate stack: two configs, each gated to its variant. Assignment is read from UserDataDocument.Experiments (sticky, stable-hash — see ExperimentAssigner).

MaxLevel.description: Maximum Board Rank. 0 = no upper bound.

MinLevel.description: Minimum Board Rank (matches PublicData.BoardRank). 0 = no lower bound.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum active premium tier (matches Premium.MaxActiveTier). 0 = no requirement.

Platforms.description: Platforms the entity is available on. Empty/null = all. Unlike the other axes this one comes from the request platform (IGSService.ClientPlatform), not from the player document, and is passed to SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes as a separate REQUIRED argument. The axis is skipped when the platform is Unknown — deliberately soft, because it governs what is shown, not what is charged: payments are guarded by PriceOptionSelector.IsAvailableOn, where Unknown does not pass a non-empty platform list. Not needed to hide entities that simply cannot be paid for on a platform: storefronts already drop whatever has no available price option.

RegisteredWithinDays.description: Registered no earlier than X days ago (new players; matches RegistrationDate). 0 = no restriction.

RequiredPremiumIDs.description: Required active premium IDs (ANY of the list is enough, via PremiumHelpers.GetActivePremiumIDs). Empty = no requirement.

Segments.description: Allowed economy segments (matches PlayerEconomyTuningState.Segment: "F2P","Dolphin","Whale","VIP"). Empty = any.

Tutorial.description: Tutorial condition: the gate passes only if the player is in the required progression state (TutorialGateCondition). null = not applied. By the same trick as Experiment, this gives "after onboarding" gating in every module already using SegmentGate, with no edits to them. To close a whole module there is a cheaper path — TutorialGlobalSettings.Blocking: one check in ClientRun instead of a condition on every entity.

TutorialGateCondition.description: "The player finished the tutorial" condition — embedded in SegmentGate.Tutorial exactly as ExperimentVariantCondition is embedded in SegmentGate.Experiment. Thanks to that, tutorial gating works for free in EVERY module already using SegmentGate (Store / DealOffer / Quest / Reward / Leaderboard / ...). This is the per-entity gating level; to close a whole module use TutorialBlockingPolicy, which is cheaper.

FlowIDs.description: Flows whose state is checked. Empty = the condition is not applied (the gate passes). Multiple entries are AND-ed: "after the intro AND after the raid tutorial".

Mode.description: What exactly must hold for those flows. Default Completed.

Negate.description: Invert the condition. Needed for the reverse case — "show this starter offer ONLY to players still in the tutorial". Default false.

SkippedCountsAsCompleted.description: Whether a Skipped flow counts as finished under Mode = Completed. Default true: if the publisher allowed skipping, the skipper must get the same game as the completer.

StepID.description: The step that must be reached. Read only when Mode = StepReached, and applied to every flow in FlowIDs.

x-enum-descriptions: The flow is finished. Default.
The flow is started (in progress or already finished).
A specific step has been reached (TutorialGateCondition.StepID).

value.description: Title data collections: a Firebase/Supabase-like store inside the platform. The creator declares structures (collections) with typed fields, searchable fields, sort keys, access rules and limits; the platform enforces tenant isolation, access, indexes, limits, deletion and billing. Use a ready platform module first (currency, items, store, quests, leaderboards, chat, workshop…); use collections only for what no module provides, or for extra data attached to module entities. Never store currencies/items in a collection — reference them and move value through the engine economy (Cost/Grant).

Collections.description: Collections of the title. Key = collection id ('guilds', 'orders'; a front-end module prefixes its namespace: 'guild-system:guilds'). Allowed: letters, digits, '_', '-', ':' up to 64 chars. No '.' or '$'.

Enabled.description: Master switch. Default false — data collections must be enabled explicitly.

Roles.description: Title user roles (admin, editor, moderator…) referenced by 'Role' access rules. Key = role id. Roles are assigned only by the server (CloudCode) and the dashboard, never by the client.
